title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00035 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: POOH w/ CSG fish on spear. Set fish in slips. Released spear and r/b same
00:45 - 01:00: Performed pre-job meeting to r/u CSG handling equipment
01:00 - 02:30: R/u handling equipment for 10 3/4in casing
02:30 - 02:45: Performed pre-job meeting to pull and l/d casing
02:45 - 07:00: Pull 10 3/4in casing from 730m to 410m. Average pulling speed 6,5 joints/hour, MAX pulling speed 9 joints/hour. Pulled 28joints totally
07:00 - 07:15: Performed pre-job meeting w/ new crew
07:15 - 08:45: Continued pulling 10 3/4in casing from 410m to 150m. Average pulling speed 13,3 joints/hour. Pulled 48 joints totally
08:45 - 09:00: Pulled FMS and installed master bushing due to low string weight
09:00 - 10:30: Continued to pull 10 3/4in casing from 150m to surface using manual slips and dog collar. Average pulling speed 8 joints/hour. Pulled totally 63 joints
10:30 - 10:45: Recovered last joint and discovered tapered mill stuck in the cut, photographed and secured prior to laying out
10:45 - 11:00: Performed pre-job meeting to r/d casing handling equipment
11:00 - 12:00: R/d casing handling equipment
12:00 - 13:00: Performed drop check and greased FWD PRS, no findings. Performed drop check and greased aft PRS, no findings
13:00 - 13:15: Performed pre-job meeting to p/u EZSV/CUTTER assembly
13:15 - 14:30: P/u and RIH EZSV/CUTTER assembly to 14. 7m
14:30 - 15:00: Continued RIH w/ EZSV/CUTTER assembly to 175m. Run carefully through wellhead/casing hanger area
15:00 - 15:15: Removed master bushing and installed ps21
15:15 - 16:30: Contiuned RIH from 175m to 854m. Restricted RIH speed to 2min/std
16:30 - 17:15: M/u TDS and run down to 879m, filled pipe. Washed setting area with 300 l/min 16 bar, set EZSV at 879m mid packer depth, tagged EZSV with 10t
17:15 - 17:30: Positioned cutter knives at 869m
17:30 - 17:45: Recorded parameters 309 l/min 18 bar, 100rpm, 1-7knm. Cut 14in casing w/ 100rpm, 310l/min. Observed pressure drop and confirmed cut window of 20cm
